name: widgetctl
description: Set up iOS Simulator Home Screen widgets with a local MCP server, CLI and API.

interface.longDescription: Add, find, edit and remove individual iOS Simulator Home Screen widgets through local MCP tools or the bundled CLI. Includes a short skill, executable runtimes, native worker and dependencies; no separate CLI installation is required. Requires macOS, Node 22.14+ and full Xcode. TypeScript and Playwright projects install the widgetctl npm package separately. Physical devices, stacks and Lock Screen widgets are unsupported.
